message: feat: getにキャッシュ、get/deleteにID検証を追加
diff:
diff --git a/src/services.py b/src/services.py
index 3949ebb..7bed2cd 100644
--- a/src/services.py
+++ b/src/services.py
@@ -1,9 +1,15 @@
 class UserService:  # renamed module
-    def __init__(self, repo):
+    def __init__(self, repo, cache=None):
         self.repo = repo
+        self.cache = cache if cache is not None else {}
 
     def get(self, user_id):
-        return self.repo.find(user_id)
+        self._validate_id(user_id)
+        if user_id in self.cache:
+            return self.cache[user_id]
+        user = self.repo.find(user_id)
+        self.cache[user_id] = user
+        return user
 
     def list_all(self):
         return self.repo.all()
@@ -15,4 +21,10 @@ class UserService:  # renamed module
         return self.repo.find(user_id) is not None
 
     def delete(self, user_id):
+        self._validate_id(user_id)
         self.repo.delete(user_id)
+        self.cache.pop(user_id, None)
+
+    def _validate_id(self, user_id):
+        if not isinstance(user_id, int) or user_id <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"不正なユーザーID: {user_id!r}")
